title: Saudi Arabian Grilled Pork Chops Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish combining traditional Saudi Arabian spices with the smoky taste of grilled pork chops.

ingredients.name: Saudi Arabian spice blend
ingredients.notes: a mix of cinnamon, cardamom, and allspice

ingredients.name: lemon juice
ingredients.notes: add a squeeze just before serving

ingredients.name: bell peppers
ingredients.notes: any color, chopped, for kebab assembly

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together Saudi Arabian spice blend, brown sugar, salt, and black pepper.
Brush both sides of pork chops with olive oil, then coat evenly with spice mixture.
Let pork chops sit at room temperature for 15-30 minutes.
Thread pork chops, onions, bell peppers, and garlic onto skewers, brushing with olive oil.
Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until internal temperature reaches 145°F.
Let kebabs rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Serve with additional lemon juice and Saudi Arabian spice blend, if desired.
Discard any leftover food and clean grill to prevent cross-contamination.
